name: @veren/startup-autostart-skill
description: Use when a DSH profile installs the Startup Autostart stack and agents must know when and how to manage startup items: it contributes one bundled, model-invocable skill named startup-autostart that explains when a recurring every-start job is the right request, how to choose among new_session, resume_session, message_session, and queue_message, the no-debounce run rules with enabled as the only gate, the input boundaries, and how to diagnose a failed item; skip it when the stack is absent or agents never touch startup items.
